head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: Spec-named server tests checked against specs 3,4,5,8,9,11,12,13,14 Tests tables; all present except those already in the known ledger (TestRoutineDetailRunHistory/routines_test.go absent, git-dir-untouched add case, TestReposDelete cross-instance case, non-developer legacy audience case, i18n template-key completeness, statusCache.Delete on delete, styleTestTarget/profile test, bootstrap status, routineSession, overview translated details, profile-save audience-change sync) - not re-reported. TestRemoveSelectedDropsCache from spec-11 exists as subtests of TestRepoRemoveSelected (clean-removal-drops-cached-rows, skip-output-leaves-cache-untouched). Tests/build not executed in this lane (head build/test is the station's buildTest input). ACTION-REVIEW-TEST-005: no test-mode identity constants in the chunk. Cross-chunk: none suspected; spec-11 shell tests and spec-14 registry tests live outside chunk 'server'.

findings.fix: Give the test server a usable token (TokenDir with a non-empty labeled token file, or a legacy token file) so the only 409 source left is the running guard, and assert the body contains "a bootstrap run is already in progress".
findings.claim: TestWelcomeBootstrapConcurrent (spec-5 Tests row 'second POST while running -> conflict response') cannot fail on the guard it names: newTestServer(t, &Options{}) has no token, so handleWelcomeBootstrap returns 409 'bootstrap needs the routine token' at bootstrap.go:61-63 even with the s.bootstrap.running check at bootstrap.go:47-50 deleted; the test only asserts the status code.
findings.evidence: Re-read bootstrap.go:44-64: running check, then bootstrapEnv("","") succeeds, then styleTestTarget() -> verifyTokenPath() (welcome.go:392-402): TokenDir "" -> LegacyTokenPath("") = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(""), "token") = "token" relative to the package cwd (internal/routines/tokens.go:28-30); git ls-files shows no internal/server/token; ListTokenLabels("") -> os.ReadDir("") ENOENT -> nil,nil (tokens.go:34-38); so TokenPath == "" and respond.WithConflict (http.Error 409, respond.go:10-12) fires. Re-read welcome_test.go:234-241: only assert.Equal(StatusConflict, code), no body check. Mutation 'delete bootstrap.go:47-50' therefore keeps the suite green.

findings.fix: Add a TestOverview subtest that writes a batch JSON after newTestServer and asserts the Sessions analyzed tile counts it on the next GET /.
findings.claim: The new request-time rescan in handleOverview (s.reloadSessions() at overview.go:85) has no test: every overview test writes its batch fixtures before newTestServer, whose New() already calls store.Reload (server.go:211-214), so deleting the line keeps the suite green while a fresh install's overview would stop seeing batches written after server start.
findings.evidence: Re-read overview.go:84-111 (reloadSessions added at 85), server.go:211-214 (initial Reload in New), overview_test.go TestOverview subtests (fixtures written at 51-65 and 147-161 before newTestServer at 77 and 162) and TestOverviewCasual:378-392 (no sessions). The only rescan-per-request test is sessions_test.go:192-201, which hits GET /sessions/{scope} (handleSessionsScope), not GET /.

findings.fix: Add a TestWorktreeStatusFragmentServesCache case on a repo where repos.Fingerprint fails (e.g. point the registry at a non-git dir with the stub status script) and assert two plain loads run the script twice and never render ' · cached'.
findings.claim: The 'fingerprint error counts as changed' guard (fingerprintErr == nil in data.Cached at repos.go:357) is untested: when Fingerprint fails it returns "" and the entry is stored with fingerprint "", so with the guard removed a second failing load matches "" == "" and serves stale rows; every status test uses reposTestEnv's git repo where Fingerprint succeeds.
findings.evidence: Re-read repos.go:347-368 and repos.Fingerprint (internal/repos/registry.go:457-468: both error returns are "", err). Store(repo.Name, fingerprint, statuses) at repos.go:363 runs whenever Status succeeds, regardless of fingerprintErr. Re-read repos_test.go:25-72 (reposTestEnv git-inits the repo) and 409-463 (ServesCache covers match, refresh=1 and new-branch mismatch only); no test exercises a Fingerprint error.
